resources.string: Set how much mpv loads ahead and keeps behind. Off: 64 MB each way. Applies from the next video.
How far ahead mpv loads, in seconds of video. It stops earlier if it reaches the size below.
The most the buffer ahead may take, in MB. A 25 Mbps remux takes about 190 MB per minute.
What mpv keeps of what you already watched, in MB, to rewind without loading again.
Uses the app's cache on storage instead of RAM, so it can be far bigger. Cleared when the video closes.

In RAM, up to 2048 MB ahead and 1024 MB behind. On storage, up to 65536 MB and 32768 MB, always leaving 2 GB free. If there is not enough room, both shrink. mpv uses these settings for anime with the Auto engine too.
